Meet JC

“I deliver, you slay.”

Johanna Camacho is a licensed nail tech running one chair, by herself, out of a private room inside By Gelica Studio on West Main.

She works dry. No soaking bowl, no water — cuticle work is done with an e-file so the skin line stays clean and gel can sit right up against it. That's why her sets grow out flat instead of lifting, and it's what the reviews keep circling back to: cuticles, structure, detail.

One person, one room, one appointment at a time. Phones down, no extra guests, hot towels and a snack if you want one. “Every appointment is designed to feel relaxed and unrushed.” Whether that ends in a bare buffed nail or a sculpted set with flowers on it is up to you.

How booking works

Three steps and you're in the chair

  1. Pick the service

    Everything she offers, with its price and how long it takes, is on her booking page. Not sure which one? Send her a note below and she'll tell you.

  2. Hold it with a deposit

    The deposit confirms the appointment and comes off your total. Move it 72 hours ahead and the deposit moves with you.

  3. Come as you are

    Free parking, a step-free entrance, hot towels, a snack if you want one. Fifteen-minute grace period, and the room is yours.
